description: Use this when someone asks which subreddits or Reddit communities fit a product, brand or niche, or where on Reddit AI answers look for recommendations in a category. Takes a short description such as "AI writing tool for marketers" and returns up to 10 matching subreddits, closest match first, with how often AI answers cited each, members and a link to each subreddit's data page. Only subreddits in CommunityMentions' data (cited 50+ times or with 50+ verified comments placed) are included; health, legal-help and adult communities are left out.

description.description: What the product or niche is, in a few words
